jules: Quick standup for the webinar launch this Wed — landing is live on staging. Need final X + LinkedIn copy and two headline variants by 3pm.

sam-prod: Upload the enterprise seed CSV and I'll wire routing. Format needs column owner_email and company_domain.

marc: Draft copies: X short: "Webinar Wed: benchmark-backed plays for predictable LLM inference. Demo + Q&A. Register -> https://redwood.ai/webinar" LinkedIn long: "Join Redwood on Wed for benchmark insights, a live demo, and practical playbooks to reduce inference cost. Panel + Q&A. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar"

izzy: Headline A: "Cut LLM cost without losing latency" Headline B: "Benchmark playbooks for inference at scale" Run A/B only on midday X slot.

design-bot: assets pushed: /Marketing/Webinars/Q2/thumbnail_1200x628.png and speaker_photos.zip. 30s clip in progress, ETA 14:15.

sam-prod: Routing rules: if owner_email present & AE online -> assign to AE. Else -> SDR queue tag=webinar_q2. Enterprise domains -> priority high. Fallback: if unclaimed in 30m -> post to #sales-sdr with templated outreach. Example template: "Thanks for registering — sharing the benchmark deck. Interested in a 15-min demo? Mornings or afternoons better?"

jules: CTA primary: Register. Secondary: Download snapshot (gated). Ensure GA event webinar_bench_dl fires on download.

ops-bot: scheduled post: platform=X time=2024-05-14T09:00:00-07:00 id=post_9901 status=queued :white_check_mark:

jules: I'll set the A/B test in the scheduler and upload the final mapping CSV by 5pm. Ping here if anything blocks.
